jobs.prompt: Create an original 30 second Korean caregiver demonstration song. Warm natural adult female voice, sparse soft acoustic plucks, gentle 70 BPM, clear Korean words, comfortable low dynamics, no children voices, no sound effects, no sudden changes. Allow pauses after each short line. Sing only these lyrics: 안녕 안녕 반가워. 네 소리를 기다려. 안녕 안녕 반가워. 우리 잠깐 쉬어요. End with a gentle fade, no loop.

jobs.prompt: Create an original 30 second Korean caregiver gesture-song demonstration, gentle 80 BPM. Only these Korean lyrics: 손을 살랑 안녕. 잠깐 쉬고 안녕. 앉아서도 안녕. 우리 이제 쉬어요. Finish naturally, not a loop.
